objective: Search beyond the certified aggregate core-radius-six barrier while all 237 residual-boundary edges remain mutable and every visited state differs on at least seven of the other 666 core edges.

prior_evidence.core_radius_6: CERTIFIED UNSAT for all assignments with at most six changed core edges
prior_evidence.proof_core_top_7_cut: CERTIFIED UNSAT for the single fixed cut containing proof-core ranks 1 through 7

strategy.name: core_kick_dynamic_swap_lns_v1
strategy.initialization: Restart zero flips proof-core ranks 1 through 7. Later restarts choose four distinct edges from ranks 1 through 64 and three distinct edges from all 666 ranked core pairs, using the run seed.
strategy.boundary_moves: Every one of the 237 edges incident to vertices 3,4,7,38,41,42 is always eligible.
strategy.core_moves: Admissible single flips maintain the registered distance interval. Dynamic changed/unchanged core swaps preserve distance and sample new proof-guided or diverse cuts.
strategy.distance_invariant: Every production state has core Hamming distance in [7,12], so no state lies inside the certified radius-six region.
strategy.selection: Weighted violated-set min-conflicts with deterministic tabu, breakout weights, random walk, bad-set core swaps, and periodic global core swaps.
